name: An Ordinary Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop tends ordinary hippogryph eggs, though only about half hatch.

sections.title: Half a Chance
sections.body: Only about half of ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch. Curgle Cranklehop does their best to nurture each one, hoping luck will see it hatch.

faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop invented the Super Egg-O-Matic and works with hippogryph eggs from Feralas.

faq.q: What happens to the ordinary hippogryph egg?
aliases: what does curgle do with the egg
faq.answer: Curgle tends the ordinary hippogryph egg and hopes for luck. Only about half of such eggs hatch.

faq.q: Where do these eggs come from?
aliases: where do i find the egg

faq.answer: The step before this one is The Super Egg-O-Matic.
